author: piztanza
description: Implement SEO + social meta (F-010): Next.js Metadata on both routes with approved copy, OG/Twitter cards with a 1200x630 brand OG image, canonical URLs via NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL (default https://mobeeli.com), robots.txt + sitemap.xml metadata routes, favicon/apple-icon from mobeeli-mark.png, theme-color #0d1522.
acceptance_criteria: Both routes expose title/description/OG/Twitter meta with approved copy (no fee figures, no incumbent names)
OG image is 1200x630 using the official dark-bg logo on #0d1522 and renders in WhatsApp/LinkedIn link previews
Canonical URLs + metadataBase derive from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL (documented in .env.example, default https://mobeeli.com)
robots.txt allows crawling and points to sitemap.xml; sitemap lists / and /join
Favicon + apple icon generated from mobeeli-mark.png; theme-color #0d1522
Suite stays green; Lighthouse SEO ≥ 90 achievable (meta present, valid HTML lang)
